limits: Aligote, Beclan, Chenin, Enfariné, Franc Noir de Haute Saone, Gamay, Marsanne, Roussane and Sacy together: at most 5%
rules.yield_base: 60 hl/ha for white, 55 for red and rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Jura appellation, in the cool climate region between Burgundy and Switzerland, for wine made from Savagnin Blanc, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Poulsard and Trousseau. Its rules also allow a partially fermented grape must made from raisined grapes. Pupillin is among its communes.
